neighbours.label: expressions of liking or appeal toward something just encountered (really liked it, sounds like what you want, like the sound of)
fire: We watched the demo yesterday and honestly loved it from the start.
If this plan sounds like a good fit, give us a call today.
My sister tasted the soup and really enjoyed it.
I quite like the idea of a four-day week at the office.
The kids played the game once and adored it straight away.
That cottage sounds perfect for a quiet weekend away.
She tried the new bike and liked it far more than the old one.
We both fancied the look of the little red car in the window.
quiet: We watched the demo yesterday and then went home by bus.
If this plan is late, give us a call today.
My sister cooked the soup and served it at six.
I quite often work a four-day week at the office.
The kids played the game once and then went to bed.
That cottage is near the lake on the north road.
She rode the new bike to school and locked it outside.
We both walked past the little red car in the window.

notes: Top tokens ' liked', ' immediately', 'sound like/of', 'potential'. Probe 0.22-0.26 on liked/sounds.
